first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A goose with a white body, a long curved neck, an orange bill tip, and orange webbed feet, continuously holding Object A in its bill.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A light-yellow, roughly rectangular-cuboid prop held in Animal A's bill, with a blue strip on its top surface and two dark dots on its side.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with short brown hair, wearing purple long sleeves, a burgundy sleeveless top, gray-brown trousers, and black shoes.

entities.name: gray street surface
entities.identification: The broad gray paved street surface where Person A and Animal A are active.

entities.name: dark-gray tiled roof
entities.identification: The dark-gray sloped roof in the lower-left foreground, with rows of tiles at frame 0; at the final frame, only part of it and faint texture are visible.

entities.name: rooftop chimney
entities.identification: A group of chimneys partially entering the frame at the foreground edges, showing reddish-brown shafts or brown top components.

entities.name: green median grass
entities.identification: A green grassy area enclosed by the light-colored curb and supporting the wooden bench and dark-green post.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: A bench with a brown wooden-plank backrest and seat, and dark legs.

entities.name: dark-green post
entities.identification: An upright dark-green column within the grass, widening in stages toward the bottom, with a nearly black bottom section.

entities.name: blue puddle
entities.identification: A flat, light-blue area with an irregular outline on the street surface.

entities.name: black-and-white ball
entities.identification: A small ball on the street behind the grass, with a white base and black polygonal patches.

entities.name: small light-blue seat-surface object
entities.identification: A small light-blue object on the seat at the right end of the wooden bench, with protruding pointed corners and a relatively slender middle section.

entities.name: object illustration bubble
entities.identification: A white, roughly circular prompt bubble above Person A's head, containing a light-yellow illustration with blue patterns corresponding to Object A.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: Another person, of whom only light-colored legs and shoes with red areas are visible at the top edge of the frame.

entities.name: light-colored curb
entities.identification: The boundary between the grass and the street surface, formed by connected narrow, elongated beige-gray segments.

entities.name: red-brick building
entities.identification: A partially visible reddish-brown brick wall, green door, and light-colored doorway border in the upper left.
